findings.message: Sensitive-field matching is exact and case-sensitive against a fixed list, so common variants (e.g. 'Password', 'TOKEN', 'auth_token', 'api_key', 'password_hash') are copied through unredacted. This silently leaks secrets into audit logs.
findings.suggestion: Normalize keys before matching (lowercase/strip separators) and match by suffix/pattern (e.g. endswith('token'), contains 'secret'/'password'/'key') or use a broader denylist; consider failing closed for unknown sensitive-looking fields.
